newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybean ends mostly mixed after falls.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybean ends mostly mixed after falls.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mixed on Monday due to a rebound after sharp falls over the past few days, traders said.
November did not trade on its last trading day. It will begin to deliver on Tuesday with open interest of 320 lots. One lot is five tonnes.
January fell four yuan to 3,171 yuan per tonne, March 19 to 3,200, July rose 10 to 3,360 and September 50 to 3,380.
Combined volume fell to 11,300 tonnes from 13,300.
Traders said soybean had a technical consolidation after sharp falls last week.

"Many investors liquidated their short positions for profit today because soybean fell too quickly last week," one trader said. "But they were not optimistic about the later market trend due to poor fundamentals," he added.
Analysts expect soybean to continue falling in the next few days, with few investors daring to hold long positions.
